label: rem:wigner-2-coefficient-interpretation
title: $h/2$ is the isospin midpoint of the Hecke spectrum
html:
Remark. The value h/2 is the arithmetic mean of the symmetric eigenvalue q and the antisymmetric eigenvalue -q^{-1}. Self-conjugate partitions occupy the exact isospin midpoint of the Hecke spectrum.

The proton-neutron crossing is invisible to [3,2,1]. Its trace contribution cancels exactly. Only pp and nn crossings contribute, doing so with opposite signs. The BW scaling for [3,2,1] is therefore proportional to the net pp minus nn asymmetry (Z - N)(A - 1), rather than the isospin Casimir T(T+1).
heading: Remark
